responsibility: Declares the token, lexer, cache, and parser data structures used by the C++ recursive-descent parser. It defines cp_token/cp_lexer/cp_parser state, parser-side queues and flags for templates, scopes, linkage, OpenMP, and deferred processing, and exposes the debugging and utility entry points needed by parser.cc and adjacent front-end code.
same_name_distinction: Defines the parser-facing data structures—cp_token, cp_lexer, token caches, queues, and cp_parser state fields—and exposes parser debugging/utilities. Unlike parser.cc, it does not implement grammar parsing; it provides the state representation the parser code operates on.
